test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Vijay sells bananas at the rate of Rs. 14 per dozen and earns a profit of 40 percent. The cost price of the bananas increases by 30 percent. If the selling price remains the same, then what is his new profit percent?
solution:
**Given:**

Vijay sells bananas at the rate of Rs. 14 per dozen and earns a profit of 40 per cent.

The cost price of bananas increases by 30 per cent.

The selling price remains the same.

**Concept Used:**

Profit% = Profit/CP × 100

**Calculation:**

SP of 12 bananas = Rs. 14

Profit % = 40 %

CP of 12 bananas = 14 × 100/140 = Rs. 10

The cost price of the bananas increases by 30 percent = 10 × 1.3 = Rs. 13

Profit = SP - CP 

⇒ 14 - 13 = Rs. 1

Profit % = 1/13 × 100 = 7.69 %

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
